# Glisse

The segmented control and its Liquid Glass engine, copied unmodified from
[0kzh/glisse](https://github.com/0kzh/glisse) (v0.5.0, MIT; see LICENSE). Only the files
the segmented control imports are included. The launcher renders them through
`preact/compat`, and `styles.css` is imported as written.

Excluded from lint and formatting so the files stay identical to upstream.
